# Jubilees Chapter 31 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

## 31:5 — Isaac's reunion speech

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "thy fragrance I smell, and thy voice I hear" | Inverted word order follows Ge'ez syntax |
| LOGOS | "I can smell your fragrance and hear your voice" | Natural English word order |
| PNEUMA | "I know your smell and your voice" | Simplified dynamic rendering |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS. The Ge'ez inverted syntax of EMET is interesting but awkward in English. PNEUMA loses "fragrance" which has deliberate echoes of the Jacob-blessing scene in chapter 26 (where Isaac also smelled Jacob's garments).

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

## 31:10-13 — priestly blessing of Levi

All three translators rendered this passage substantially similarly, with minor differences in register. The primary disagreement was over "priestly people" vs. "priestly nation."

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "a priestly people unto him" | Literal; "people" renders the Ge'ez 'am |
| LOGOS | "a priestly people to him" | Same |
| PNEUMA | "a priestly nation" | "Nation" rather than "people" |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** "Priestly people" adopted following EMET/LOGOS. The Ge'ez 'am consistently maps to "people" throughout the project; "nation" (goy) is a different term.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET/LOGOS.

---

## 31:20 — "spirit of prophecy"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "the spirit of prophecy descended upon Isaac's mouth" | Literal anatomical specificity of Ge'ez |
| LOGOS | "the spirit of prophecy descended upon Isaac's mouth" | Same |
| PNEUMA | "the spirit of prophecy fell on Isaac" | Drops the "mouth" specification |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Retained "descended upon Isaac's mouth" following EMET/LOGOS. The Ge'ez specification of the mouth is deliberate — it is the mouth that speaks the inspired words. PNEUMA's generalization loses this precision.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET/LOGOS.

---
